title: One MLLM, One Call: Efficient Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation via Spatial-Aware Waypoints
abstract: arXiv:2609.06476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to navigate unseen environments by following natural language instructions. Current zero-shot VLN-CE methods either rely on pre-trained waypoint predictors or require multiple queries to large models per step. To address prohibitive inference latency and computational overhead, we propose O2C-Nav, an efficient zero-shot navigation framework that calls only a single large model once per decision step. Our approach introduces a training-free structured waypoint generator and a novel abstract representation that projects sparse, history-aware candidate waypoints directly onto RGB images as visual markers. The MLLM selects a waypoint or generates a fallback target bounding box at each step, while a low-level Fast Marching Method (FMM) planner converts the selected target into an executable collision-free path. translated_title: 一个多模态大模型，一次调用：通过空间感知路径点实现高效的零样本视觉语言导航
translated_abstract: 持续环境中的视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）要求具身智能体通过遵循自然语言指令在未见过的环境中进行导航。当前的零样本VLN-CE方法要么依赖预训练的路径点预测器，要么每一步都需要多次查询大型模型。为了解决过高的推理延迟和计算开销问题，我们提出了O2C-Nav，一个高效的零样本导航框架，它在每个决策步骤只调用一次大型模型。我们的方法引入了一种免训练的结构化路径点生成器以及一种新颖的抽象表示方法，将稀疏的、具有历史感知能力的候选路径点直接投影到RGB图像上作为视觉标记。多模态大模型（MLLM）在每一步选择一个路径点或生成一个回退目标边界框，同时底层的快速行进法（FMM）规划器将选定的目标转换为可执行的无碰撞路径。这种范式为模型提供了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出O2C-Nav高效零样本导航框架，每个决策步骤仅需调用一次多模态大模型，通过将空间感知的历史候选路径点直接投影到RGB图像上作为视觉标记，大幅降低推理延迟和计算开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes O2C-Nav, an efficient zero-shot navigation framework that requires only a single MLLM call per decision step by projecting sparse, history-aware spatial candidate waypoints onto RGB images as visual markers, dramatically reducing inference latency and computational overhead.
